var_ContactId.title: var_ContactId
var_ContactId.description: The diner's numeric Contact ID / External Diner ID (e.g., 99999999).

var_PartySize.title: var_PartySize
var_PartySize.description: The number of dining guests in the party.

var_ReservationTime.title: var_ReservationTime
var_ReservationTime.description: The target reservation date and time formatted in ISO-8601 with the local timezone offset of the restaurant (e.g., 2026-10-26T16:30:00-05:00 for 4:30 PM in Austin/Chicago, 2026-10-26T16:30:00-04:00 for New York/Miami, or 2026-10-26T16:30:00-07:00 for Los Angeles). NEVER append 'Z' to local times.

var_RestaurantId.title: var_RestaurantId
var_RestaurantId.description: The custom restaurant code from the Restaurant_ID__c field (e.g., REST-ATX-01, REST-NYC-01). DO NOT pass the 18-character Salesforce record ID starting with a03. Always pass the human-readable Restaurant_ID__c code.

var_SpecialRequests.title: var_SpecialRequests
var_SpecialRequests.description: Optional guest notes, including dietary restrictions, food allergies, seating preferences, or special celebrations (anniversary, birthday, business meal).
